title: Exact pullback and tensor shifts with generator squares on K-flat representatives
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Use the shared derived categories $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and $D(\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-pc-derived-category], the K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and $F=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] with any supplied strong monoidal structure. There exist coherent integer-shift structures $s_F$, $s_Y(M)$ and $s_Z(M)$ on $F$ and every $T_M=(-\otimes^{\mathbf L}M)$, making $F$ and these tensor functors triangulated. Write $c_G(K):G(K[1])\to G(K)[1]$ for the degree-one comparison of a functor with its chosen shift structure, and $Q_X$ for the localization of cochain complexes on $X$. For every derived morphism $b:M\to N$ on $Z$ and every K-flat cochain complex $P$ of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], let $K=Q_Z(P)$ and $\tau_b(K)=1_K\otimes b$. Then $c_{T_M}(K)\circ\tau_b(K)[1]=\tau_b(K[1])\circ c_{T_N}(K)$, with composition written in Lean's diagrammatic order. For every $M\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and every K-flat cochain complex $P$ on $Y$, let $K=Q_Y(P)$ and let $\delta_M(K):F(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}M)\to F(K)\otimes^{\mathbf L}F(M)$ be the supplied inverse tensorator. Then $c_{T_M\,F}(K)\circ\delta_M(K)[1]=\delta_M(K[1])\circ c_{F\,T_{F(M)}}(K)$, again in diagrammatic order. These two squares are required only at K-flat representatives and only for shift by one; no square at an arbitrary derived object or other integer is part of this statement.

proof.text: Use the canonical tensor shift on both scheme derived categories and the canonical pullback shift construction. Canonical tensor shift properties supply exactness of tensorRight on both schemes. Naturality of the canonical bifunctor shift gives the Z tensor-morphism square, while the pullback canonical construction supplies the inverse-tensorator square.
